description: The cord is made of dark wool, twisted tight and worn smooth where it has been handled. There are six knots along its length, each one tied with a different, uneven tension. It feels heavy for its size and has a faint scent of old dust and woodsmoke. She never said who each knot is for, and she never tried to explain the cord itself, but she carries it everywhere.
status_note: Approved at Roc's gate 2026-08-05, with the material changed from grass to wool.
soul_link_note: Ilsa counts arrivals against a number she never says — the cord is that count given a body she can keep in a pocket. The tally is of her people, not of any workplace, so it holds true whatever seat she is dealt next life.
